purpose: Claim-to-evidence ledger implemented before follow-up results; source files are immutable and each evidence path is hashed.

evidence_vocabulary.independently_reconstructed: independent calculation from archived local inputs/outputs, not independent human adjudication
evidence_vocabulary.not_completed: explicit pending work; no completion claim

claims.claim: 224 documents, 225 chunks, 364 questions and 104 attacks are publicly available and their construction is auditable.
claims.manuscript_action: Update old blanket-unavailability wording.
claims.limitation: Snapshot reconstruction does not independently authenticate all inherited facts or reproduce historical output.

claims.claim: The original 21,840-row principal execution has been freshly reproduced.
claims.manuscript_action: Do not assert; retain only reported historical numbers with explicit missing-archive limit.
claims.limitation: Exact original response archive, matching source/config and run manifest were not recovered.

claims.claim: At full budget, historical no-defense ASR was 73.1% and reranked ASR 72.1%.
claims.manuscript_action: Historical context only; caption and table identify reported source.
claims.limitation: No independent response-level recalculation in current implementation.

claims.claim: The 3,016-row repetition/accepted-label study has response-level reproducibility evidence here.
claims.manuscript_action: Mark archive gap; do not pool with C doses or committed diagnostic.
claims.limitation: If neither original nor new repetition analysis is available, its expert-comment gap remains open.

claims.claim: Current public workbench is the original principal implementation.
claims.manuscript_action: Distinguish versions and active ranking behavior.
claims.limitation: Backend-family and row-count similarity cannot establish code identity.

claims.claim: 21,840 rows are independent experimental samples.
claims.manuscript_action: Use question/fact groups and distinguish attack-selection seeds.
claims.limitation: Three selection seeds are not repeated generative draws.

evidence.meaning: 168 facts with two phrasings and related years

claims.claim: No observed clean cost proves safe rejection of legitimate documents.
claims.manuscript_action: Report narrow benchmark observation and coverage limitation.
claims.limitation: The rejected legitimate facts are not directly tested by the original question set.

evidence.meaning: Two rejected mineral chunks have no gold question

claims.claim: Study B used real gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 inference and neural API embeddings.
claims.manuscript_action: Retain actual model and executed-scope statement.
claims.limitation: Archive consistency is not third-party provider-origin certification.

claims.claim: 1,280 condition rows represent 376 distinct generation requests and 904 reuses.
claims.manuscript_action: Report both condition and unique-request counts.
claims.limitation: Cached condition reuse does not create independent generations.

claims.claim: 34/64 targeted and 17/64 reranked outputs contain only the designated false number.
claims.manuscript_action: Keep archived numerical results; attach separate reference and evaluator reanalysis.
claims.limitation: Some designated false values/references require source adjudication; number presence is not semantic endorsement.

claims.claim: The numerical accuracy field establishes factual correctness.
claims.manuscript_action: Name lexical/numerical metric accurately and report separate evaluation axes.
claims.limitation: Negation, qualifications, wrong entities and UNKNOWN-plus-number cases require interpretation.

claims.claim: Targeted versus unrelated results isolate generator robustness at equal exposure.
claims.manuscript_action: Call it end-to-end targeting; use separately fixed-context follow-up for equal exposure.
claims.limitation: Targeted any-insertion exposure is 64/64 versus 16/64 unrelated without defense.

claims.claim: Reducing success from 34 to 17 means 17 attacks were prevented with no new failures.
claims.manuscript_action: Report 24 prevented, 11 numerical restorations and 7 newly successful cases.
claims.limitation: Net endpoint difference conceals newly introduced failures and incomplete restoration.

claims.claim: Filtering demonstrates operational authentication or fact checking.
claims.manuscript_action: Describe an ideal supplied-label gate and its exact predicate.
claims.limitation: The trusted-label authority, authentication, protected audit and authorization workflow are not implemented.

evidence.meaning: All clean labels accepted; base insertions rejected

claims.claim: Accepted-label experiment demonstrates a real compromise of document approval.
claims.manuscript_action: Call it metadata-only intervention in attacker capability.
claims.limitation: Direct field mutation in a fixture is not an intrusion test.

claims.claim: The 64 questions remain untouched final test data for tuning the follow-up.
claims.manuscript_action: Keep B retrospective and use new prospectively frozen follow-up cases.
claims.limitation: Original held-out output timing does not restore freshness after observed outcomes guide changes.

claims.claim: Differences between A and B isolate the effect of replacing extraction by an LLM.
claims.manuscript_action: Report studies separately.
claims.limitation: Material, retriever, attack grid and answerer all differ.

claims.claim: A weak empty-cache pre-dispatch guard proves archived results were tampered with.
claims.manuscript_action: Fix guard prospectively without accusing the valid archive.
claims.limitation: Preventive weakness and evidence of historical tampering are separate questions.

claims.claim: Independent human semantic review has been completed.
claims.manuscript_action: Keep genuine review as pending and prepare reviewer materials; no invented human labels.
claims.limitation: Owner explicitly requested that this work not be dropped; AI source audit and deterministic metrics cannot complete it.

claims.claim: Printed affiliation identifies the actual authorized institutional approver of every source.
claims.manuscript_action: State only dataset-constructor label assignment unless real approval evidence is supplied.
claims.limitation: No named official, approval record or authorization service is evidenced by these fields.

claims.claim: No public repository exists for this project.
claims.manuscript_action: Cite pinned public repository while distinguishing local B/C artifacts from committed contents.
claims.limitation: Public code and canonical inputs do not imply all historical runs or the local new studies were published.

evidence.meaning: Public repository and original historical statement

claims.claim: Local hashes establish source authenticity and truth.
claims.manuscript_action: Use hashes for archive identity/integrity only.
claims.limitation: A matching digest does not certify factual truth, provider origin or approval authority.

claims.claim: Public benchmark selection proves independence from model pretraining.
claims.manuscript_action: Disclose public source and restricted overlap checks.
claims.limitation: No pretraining-membership test or source-family independence proof was performed.

claims.claim: All four existing figures are preserved unchanged as source assets.
claims.manuscript_action: Preserve originals and captions/version labels in final manuscript; separately add changed-result figures.
claims.limitation: Final PDF/DOCX embedding and caption accuracy must still be checked during release.

claims.claim: The new follow-up experiment has produced final results.
claims.manuscript_action: Fill only from actual completed frozen-run manifests after execution.
claims.limitation: Planning or dataset preparation is not completed real inference.

required_live_updates_after_root_executi: C-executed actual run status and final counts
new reference audit and evaluator outputs appended as evidence rather than overwriting archived B scores
